name: DSO-11: metrics-collector investigation
description: Observed lab behavior, not automated detection coverage. No proven SSH brute force, miner, host escape, sensitive-data exfiltration or functional pod recreation.

techniques.comment: Pod metrics-collector created by kubernetes-admin, auditID d2f4227c-76d4-440b-84ca-3374607f23c8, 201; alpine:latest with stress-ng shell payload. Pod is not privileged.
Live pod manifest and ps show /bin/sh -c running apk, stress-ng and a curl loop. Container startup execution, not attacker kubectl exec.

metrics-collector name, Prometheus metrics aggregation description and platform-team maintainer conflict with observed CPU stress workload. Behavioral masquerading; identity of the human operator unknown.

metrics-maintenance CronJob */5 * * * * creates Jobs. Code only checks pod and echoes recovery text. Default SA receives 403. Scheduled execution confirmed, autonomous recreation of collector is not implemented.
